items.text: Strontium is an element in Group 2 of the Periodic Table and bromine is an element in Group 7.

items.label: list_item
items.text: a Explain what happens in terms of electrons when an atom of strontium combines with an atom of bromine to form strontium bromide. You may draw a diagram to illustrate your answer. (ε)

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Explain in terms of structure and bonding whether you would expect strontium bromide to have a high or a low melting point.

items.label: list_item
items.text: c Explain what you understand by the term 'relative atomic mass' of an element.

items.label: list_item
items.text: d The natural abundances of the two isotopes of bromine are: 79Br 50.69% 81Br 49.31% Calculate the relative atomic mass of bromine. Give your answer to 2 decimal places.
